faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
Q2. How do I apply for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 26 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for IIT Roorkee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Consolidated fellowship of Rs. 80,000 (+ HRA) per month for two years, plus contingency of Rs. 50,000/year.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering / Environmental Engineering / Mechanical Engineering / Energy Engineering, with 3 or more internationally referred high-quality SCI journal articles as first author from the Ph.D. research; hands-on experience on characterization and quantification equipment along with continuous flow experiments.

faq.question: Q5. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must have published 3 or more internationally referred high-quality SCI journal articles as first author from Ph.D. research. Should have hands-on experience on characterization (XRD, FESEM, TEM, BET, XRF, XPS etc) and quantification equipment (COD, BOD, TOC, GC-MS, LC-MS) with continuous flow experiments.

faq.question: Q6. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Fellowship duration is two years. Fellowship may be terminated by either side by giving one-month notice.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Department of Chemical Engineering, IIT Roorkee, Roorkee.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Covering letter; Curriculum vitae; PhD degree (Provisional or final certificate); List of publications; Research Statement; Any other relevant documents.
